Owner: phase 011 review frontier mode (review evidence edges, 7c6a2d9a7e5). runtime/scripts/upsert.cjs:386 folds a leaf-sent FINDING node onto finding:<id> even when deriveReviewFindingEvidence placed a reused id at finding:<id>#<iteration>, so a later RESOLVES edge can target the wrong finding. Fixing it means deciding how leaf graph events address a re-keyed finding, a design choice in the evidence-edge contract, not a small fix.

Owner: the coordinator, with the expansive-budget change in progress. deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:2535 carries an unspent band share forward only once a band holds no open node, so a node closed exhausted/budget can reopen when an earlier band later empties. The budget work being built now changes this projection.

Owner: phase 010 research frontier mode. deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:2684 takes resolvedAtIteration from the store row's iteration (0 for a seed) when the close is a projection-only budget close. The lane notes no consumer reads resolvedAtIteration today; which iteration a projected close records is the owner's call.
